def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Background is the dominant color. A color bar crossing the grid is
    # retained, while any partial same-color bar is extended in color 1.
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Demo: partial horizontal bar is completed to the right with 1.
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        colors = [x for x in row if x != bg]
        if colors and len(set(colors)) == 1:
            color = colors[0]
            start = next(i for i,x in enumerate(row) if x == color)
            end = max(i for i,x in enumerate(row) if x == color)
            # If bar ends before edge, replace remaining background by 1.
            if end < w-1:
                for c in range(end+1,w):
                    if row[c] == bg: out[r][c] = 1
    return out
PY
